## SECTION 2 — BUSINESS & MOAT

- **(b) Captive installed-base / recurring annuity:** the cumulative global card fleet is a sticky, high-margin annuity. **Value-Added Services & Solutions (VASS)** is ~40% of revenue, compounding ~18–20% at ~97% gross margin [Estimate, catalyst brief; direction confirmed by Q2 net-revenue +14% and operating-margin expansion to 60.2% [Actual, PRIMARY P1]].
